definition: Narrative Science was a natural language generation company based in Chicago, Illinois, that specialized in data storytelling.
details: As of December 17, 2021, Narrative Science was acquired by Salesforce and has been integrated into Salesforce's Tableau Software.

explainer.lead: Narrative Science was a Chicago-based natural language generation company specialising in data storytelling. It was acquired by Salesforce as of December 17, 2021, and integrated into Tableau Software.

tiers.eli5: It was a company that turned tables of data into written stories, and it later became part of Salesforce's Tableau.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers working with automated data storytelling may encounter its technology within Salesforce's Tableau; note it no longer operates as an independent company.
tiers.paperLevel: It was a natural language generation company focused on data storytelling; no formal definition applies.

explainer.example: A dataset of game statistics could be turned into a written summary article by such a system.
